subject.title: [Bug]: tools/sandbox: MEDIA_MAX_BYTES (5 MB) is hardcoded and not user-configurable

question: What bounded media-store and sandbox-staging size-limit contract should OpenClaw support, including the default, hard maximum, and precedence with agents.defaults.mediaMaxMb and channel mediaMaxMb?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but choosing the permanent config/default contract changes sandbox and resource boundaries and cannot be safely inferred from partial existing media settings.

options.title: Define a bounded shared limit contract
options.body: Add or reuse a documented validated limit with secure defaults and a hard maximum, then wire all affected media paths to the same resolved value.

options.title: Land only the Telegram slice first
options.body: Review the focused Telegram PR for immediate outbound document relief while keeping this issue open for the broader store and sandbox-staging contract.

options.title: Keep the fixed core cap
options.body: Reject configurability and document the 5 MiB store/staging cap as a hard boundary, accepting continued failures for larger sandboxed media unless per-path exceptions exist.

recommendation.title: Define a bounded shared limit contract
recommendation.body: Add or reuse a documented validated limit with secure defaults and a hard maximum, then wire all affected media paths to the same resolved value.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses sandbox/media security boundaries where steipete has the strongest history signal from current code provenance.
